title: stream.sample payload
description: One measured sample from a hardware adapter. Attached to the envelope with type 'stream.sample'.

device.description: Device name as declared by its driver.

value.description: Raw sample value in the channel's own unit. Never rescaled here; unit belongs to the channel descriptor.

t_seconds.description: Monotonic device time in seconds. Device time is not simulation time and the two are never mixed.

quality.description: Sensor self-assessment. 'invalid' samples must not be fed to any module.
